versions.changelog:
Initial release – simplifies remembering and finding your parking spot in large or unfamiliar locations.

- Log parking details: level, row, section/color, photo, paid-until time, and notes at park time.
- Instantly retrieve your spot with elapsed time and level-first search guidance.
- Tracks meter/session expiry and alerts before/after paid time runs out.
- Maintains per-location history so repeat visits are easier.
- One-command capture and retrieval workflows for busy, distracted moments.
